name: Coordinator decide(autoresearch) → autoresearch-baseline
description: ADR-042 §Phase 2 redesign — second category pack. First rule of the autoresearch category. Fires when a coordinator loop terminates with decide(action=autoresearch, reason=<user's autoresearch intent prose>). Spawns autoresearch-baseline with the coordinator loop ID as the RUN ENTITY (mirrors research pack's PLAN-loop-as-run-entity pattern). Baseline is responsible for parsing the four autoresearch parameters (command, surface, cap, metric_parser) out of the coordinator's reason text via its own LLM iteration, then stamping them onto the run entity via emit_autoresearch_baseline. The structured-params soft contract lives in the coordinator persona (10-decision-contract.md autoresearch entry) and autoresearch-baseline persona, NOT in the rule wire format — the wire stays the canonical decide(action, reason, subtopics, retry_hint) shape, no per-category schema branching.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.autoresearch-baseline
on_enter.prompt:
AUTORESEARCH BASELINE — parse parameters + establish metric reference.

A coordinator at loop $entity.instance classified the user's message as an autoresearch ask. Its loop entity is your RUN ENTITY — every iteration's experiment loops accumulate state on it via subject override.

You have two jobs in this single loop:

**Job 1 — Parse the four autoresearch parameters from the coordinator's terminal.**

Iteration 1 — call read_loop_result(loop_id=$entity.instance). The reason field contains the user's autoresearch intent as the coordinator preserved it. Extract:

- **command** — the executable measurement command (e.g. `task test:integration`). Must be a single shell command runnable in the sandbox.
- **surface** — file globs the propose phase may edit (e.g. `test/, Taskfile.yml`). The smaller, the more honest — never grant the full repo.
- **cap** — integer iteration cap. v1 stop condition. Reasonable defaults: 10 for cheap measurements (<30s/iter), 5 for slow ones.
- **metric_parser** — instructions for extracting a numeric value from the command's stdout. Lower-is-better semantics in v1. Example: `last line matching '^Total time: ([0-9.]+)s$', capture group 1, parse as float`.

If any of the four is genuinely ambiguous in the coordinator's reason, decide(action="needs_clarification", reason="<which parameter is ambiguous and why>") — the recovery rule routes back to the coordinator to tighten with the user.

**Job 2 — Establish the baseline.**

Iteration 2 — bash: run the command verbatim in the sandbox. Capture stdout (head + tail; under 100KB cap) AND exit code. Apply the metric_parser to extract a single numeric value.

Iteration 3 — call emit_autoresearch_baseline with all parsed parameters AND the baseline measurement:

```
emit_autoresearch_baseline(
  command="<from job 1>",
  surface="<from job 1>",
  cap=<from job 1>,
  metric_parser="<from job 1>",
  baseline_value=<measured number>,
  baseline_pass=<bool — true iff exit code 0>,
  baseline_stdout_tail="<last ~200 chars for audit>"
)
```

The tool stamps autoresearch.{command, surface, cap, metric_parser, baseline.value, baseline.pass, baseline.stdout_tail, best.value, best.experiment_id} on the RUN entity (subject override to $entity.triple.lineage.run-loop-entity-id — the spawn-time-stable reference that sidesteps the semstreams#159 race). best.value initializes to baseline.value; best.experiment_id initializes to "baseline".

Terminal: decide(action="propose", reason="baseline measured: value=<n> pass=<bool>; command=<verbatim>; surface=<verbatim>; cap=<n>; metric_parser=<verbatim>") to forward into the iteration loop. The reason is the handoff payload — keep all parsed parameters AND the measurement in it so the propose phase has the context.

If the baseline command crashes (exit code non-zero) OR the metric_parser cannot extract a number, decide(action="needs_clarification", reason="baseline establish failed: <specific reason>") — recovery routes to coordinator.

Per ADR-041 addendum 2026-05-15: chain agents do not query the graph; bash + read_loop_result are your only read channels.

metadata.run_entity_pattern: Coordinator's own loop entity IS the run entity for the iteration loop. Subsequent iterations stamp accumulator triples (autoresearch.experiment.completed, .best.value, .stop.reason) on this entity via subject override. Mirrors research pack's PLAN-loop-as-run-entity pattern.
metadata.wire_shape_rationale: The decide tool stays canonical (action + reason + subtopics + retry_hint). The four autoresearch parameters are parsed by autoresearch-baseline from the coordinator's reason field, not encoded in the wire. Rationale: per-category positional-subtopic encoding (.0/.1/.2/.3) would need an .N indexed substitution that does not ship in beta.86 (only .length and .triples exist on the suffix-substitution family); per-category keyed-args would proliferate decide-tool schemas across packs. The LLM-side parse is bounded by the strict emit_autoresearch_baseline schema — if the LLM mis-parses, emit fails structurally and the loop retries.
metadata.tool_choice_rationale: Required-mode keeps gemini-flash on the tool path through both bash (measurement) and emit_autoresearch_baseline (commit). Without it, the baseline measurement risks text-only completion (semstreams#158 class).
